capabilities: Chat with OpenAI-compatible models directly inside Markdown notes
Branch conversations using nested headings in the same note
Configure per-note models and system prompt files via frontmatter
Render citations from search-integrated models like Perplexity Sonar
Generate and edit images from within notes
extras: Screenshots and the branching-conversation example live on separate linked pages rather than in the README; manual installation instructions and developer setup are included.
intentEvidence: ChatGPT-MD Obsidian plugin, but I preferred to use the official OpenAI nodejs library
motivation: The author preferred gptel's nested-heading branching approach and the official OpenAI nodejs library over the existing ChatGPT-MD plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hold AI conversations inside notes, let alone several branching threads organized by heading nesting.

relations.evidence: gptel LLM client for Emacs, and especially its branching context feature
ChatGPT-MD Obsidian plugin, but I preferred to use the official OpenAI nodejs library

summary: AI chat plugin that writes GPT-4o and Claude responses into Markdown notes as nested headings, supporting multiple branching conversations per note.
